author: Aristotle
notes: Use Bekker locators as the human-stable citation. Source-derived claims are bound to immutable passage witnesses from the pinned First1K Greek edition; `python3 scripts/source_evidence.py verify` hash-checks that edition before it is used. Initial claims use the four-causes discussion at II.3, 194b16-195a3 and the definition of change at III.1, 201a10-11. III.1 begins at 200b12, where Aristotle motivates investigating change; that opening is context, not the definition's locator.
